# ADR-NNN — Decision title

Template only; no accepted decision or allocated ID exists in this file.
For a real ADR, record `accepted` or `superseded by ADR-MMM`, the ticket and date.

## Context

Describe the costly-to-reverse framework, storage, API or dependency choice.

## Decision

State the selected option and evidence supporting it.

## Options rejected (why)

Record credible alternatives and the reasons for rejecting them.

## Consequences

Explain costs, constraints, risks and migration implications.

Never edit an accepted ADR to change its decision; supersede it with a new ADR.
